messages:
meera: Heads-up: customer ACME reporting repeated `structured_output: invalid_json` errors in JSON mode since ~09:10 PDT. They hit our API with schema v2. Steps and logs below. Can SRE + Support look?

alex: On it. any sample request/response?

meera: sample request:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "prompt": "Extract order fields",
  "response_mode": "json",
  "schema": {"order_id":"int","items":"list"}
}
```

sam: getting parse_error 400: "Response not valid JSON: Unexpected token '<' at position 1". Traced to model gptx-8q in us-west-2. Seen in traces: span id 0x3f5a.

meera: Datadog shows json_parse_failures spike: 0.3% -> 4.7% in last 45m. Dashboard: https://app.datadog/.../dash/abcd (customer-facing redacted link)

alex: Can we avoid logging raw user input? Current failure traces include emails and tokens. Propose scalar redaction rules: regex `(\b\w+@\w+\.\w+\b)|(ssn:\s*\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4})` and drop `Authorization` header from failure store.

sam: repro steps I used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"prompt":"...","response_mode":"json","schema":{}}'
```
Response: 500 then client retried -> duplicate tokens billed. Noted increased billing on their account.

ingest-bot: deploy-bot: rolled back gptx-8q-canary at 09:22 UTC due to error rate > 2% :rotating_light:

alex: I'll add metric `service.structured_output.parse_rate` and an alert at 1% with 5m window. Also add dashboard panel with top 10 endpoints and top failing model variants. Will set trace sampling to capture 1% of all failures and ensure payloads are sanitized before sending to traces.

meera: Mitigation steps for support runbook: 1) Enable per-customer fallback_model=gptx-std; 2) Turn on `response_mode: text` fallback for JSON failures; 3) Patch log pipeline to apply redaction regex at ingestion; 4) Notify billing to refund duplicate tokens for ACME ticket #5241.

sam: I'll push a short-lived lambda to scrub keys (email, token, ssn) before storing failures. ETA 2 hours. Will also add a docs note about schema drift detection.

julia: (ACME) Thanks team — the logs did contain customer emails, please prioritize redaction. Appreciate the rollback and quick follow-up :heart:

meera: Assigned: @alex (SRE) dashboard/alert, @sam (infra) scrubber + route fallback, support ops to coordinate refund. I'll update ticket and follow up in 30m.
